_about: Everyday North American dinners TheMealDB doesn't have. Written for Flyer Meal; photos come from each dish's Wikipedia article (see flyermeal_recipes.py). A swap lets the cook use a store-bought sauce instead of making it: 'replaces' names ingredients exactly as listed here.

recipes.name: Spaghetti and Meatballs

ingredients.name: parmesan
ingredients.measure: 1/2 cup grated, plus more to serve

steps: Mix the beef, egg, breadcrumbs, parmesan, 2 grated garlic cloves, 1 tsp salt and some pepper. Roll into 16 balls about the size of a golf ball.
Brown the meatballs in the oil in a large pan over medium-high heat, turning, for about 6 minutes. Lift them onto a plate.
Make the sauce: cook the chopped onion and remaining garlic in the same pan for 5 minutes. Stir in the tomato paste, then the crushed tomatoes and oregano. Simmer 10 minutes.
Return the meatballs to the sauce, cover and simmer 15 minutes until cooked through.
Meanwhile boil the spaghetti in salted water until al dente. Drain and toss with some of the sauce.
Serve the spaghetti topped with meatballs, more sauce, torn basil and parmesan.

swaps.label: Use jarred pasta sauce
swaps.note: In step 3, cook the onion and garlic, then pour in the jar of pasta sauce and heat it through before adding the meatballs.

recipes.name: Baked Ziti
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Boil the pasta 2 minutes less than the package says, then drain.
Brown the sausage with the chopped onion in a large pan, breaking it up. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Make the sauce: add the crushed tomatoes and basil and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir the pasta into the sauce with the ricotta in spoonfuls and half the mozzarella.
Spread in a 9x13 baking dish, top with the rest of the mozzarella and the parmesan, and bake 20 minutes until bubbling and golden.

swaps.label: Use jarred pasta sauce
swaps.note: In step 3, pour the jar of pasta sauce over the browned sausage and heat it through.

recipes.name: Baked Mac and Cheese
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Boil the macaroni 2 minutes less than the package says and drain.
Melt the butter in a pot, stir in the flour and cook 1 minute. Slowly whisk in the milk and simmer until thick, about 5 minutes.
Off the heat, stir in 2 1/2 cups of the cheddar, the mustard, salt and pepper until smooth.
Fold in the macaroni, pour into a baking dish and top with the rest of the cheese and the breadcrumbs.
Bake 20 minutes until golden on top.

recipes.name: Chicken Parmesan
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Season the cutlets, dip in flour, then beaten egg, then panko mixed with the parmesan.
Fry in 1/4 inch of oil over medium-high heat, 3 minutes a side, until golden. Set in a baking dish.
Make the sauce: cook the garlic in a little oil for 30 seconds, add the tomatoes and oregano and simmer 10 minutes.
Spoon sauce over each cutlet, top with mozzarella and bake 10 to 12 minutes until the cheese bubbles.
Serve over spaghetti with the extra sauce.

swaps.label: Use jarred pasta sauce
swaps.note: Skip step 3 and spoon warmed jarred pasta sauce over the cutlets instead.

recipes.name: Penne alla Vodka
steps: Boil the penne in salted water until al dente. Save 1 cup of the pasta water, then drain.
Make the sauce: melt the butter and cook the finely chopped onion 5 minutes, then the garlic for 1 minute. Stir in the tomato paste and chili flakes and cook 3 minutes until brick red.
Add the vodka and let it bubble off, then stir in the cream.
Toss in the penne, the parmesan and splashes of pasta water until glossy.

swaps.label: Use jarred vodka sauce
swaps.note: Skip steps 2 and 3: warm the jar of vodka sauce in the pot, then toss with the penne, parmesan and a splash of pasta water.

recipes.name: Shrimp Scampi
steps: Boil the linguine in salted water until al dente.
Meanwhile heat the oil and 2 tbsp butter in a large pan. Cook the sliced garlic and chili flakes 1 minute.
Add the shrimp in one layer and cook 1 to 2 minutes a side until pink. Pour in the wine and simmer 2 minutes.
Stir in the rest of the butter, the lemon juice and parsley, then toss with the drained linguine.

recipes.name: Pesto Chicken Pasta
steps: Boil the fusilli in salted water until al dente. Save 1/2 cup of the water and drain.
Season the chicken and cook in a little oil, 6 minutes a side, until cooked through. Slice.
Make the pesto: blend the basil, pine nuts, parmesan, garlic and olive oil until smooth. Season with salt.
Toss the pasta with the pesto, tomatoes, chicken and a splash of the pasta water.

swaps.label: Use jarred pesto
swaps.note: Skip step 3 and toss the pasta with the jar of pesto.

recipes.name: Tuna Noodle Casserole
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Boil the noodles 2 minutes less than the package says and drain.
Make the sauce: melt the butter, cook the mushrooms 5 minutes, stir in the flour, then slowly add the milk and stock. Simmer until thick.
Stir in 1 cup of the cheddar, the tuna, peas and noodles. Season.
Spread in a baking dish, top with the rest of the cheese and the breadcrumbs, and bake 20 minutes.

swaps.label: Use canned cream of mushroom soup
swaps.note: Skip step 2: mix the soup with 1 cup of the milk, then carry on from step 3.

recipes.name: Butter Chicken
steps: Toss the chicken with the yogurt, 1 tsp garam masala, the cumin, paprika and 1 tsp salt. Leave 15 minutes or up to a day in the fridge.
Cook the rice according to the package.
Brown the chicken in 1 tbsp butter over high heat, in batches. Set aside.

Make the sauce: melt the rest of the butter, cook the onion 6 minutes, then the garlic and ginger 1 minute. Add the tomato sauce and the rest of the garam masala and simmer 10 minutes. Blend smooth if you like.
Stir in the cream and chicken and simmer 8 minutes until cooked through. Serve over rice with cilantro.

swaps.label: Use jarred butter chicken sauce
swaps.note: Skip step 4: pour the jar of butter chicken sauce over the browned chicken and simmer 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Chicken Fajitas
steps: Toss the chicken with the chili powder, cumin, paprika, garlic powder, 1 tsp salt, half the lime juice and 1 tbsp oil.
Cook the peppers and onion in the rest of the oil in a hot skillet for 6 minutes until charred at the edges. Set aside.
Cook the chicken in the same skillet 6 to 7 minutes until cooked through. Return the vegetables and squeeze over the rest of the lime.
Warm the tortillas and fill with the chicken and peppers, sour cream, salsa and cheese.

swaps.label: Use a fajita seasoning packet
swaps.note: In step 1, toss the chicken with the seasoning packet instead of the spices.

recipes.name: Chicken Quesadillas
steps: Sprinkle half of each tortilla with cheese, chicken, beans and green onion, then more cheese. Fold over.
Cook in a lightly buttered skillet over medium heat, 2 to 3 minutes a side, until golden and the cheese melts.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa and sour cream.

recipes.name: Roast Chicken with Potatoes

ingredients.name: thyme
ingredients.measure: a few sprigs or 1 tsp dried

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Pat the chicken dry, rub with the butter and season well inside and out.
Put the halved lemon, garlic and thyme inside the chicken.
Toss the potatoes and carrots with the oil and salt in a roasting pan and set the chicken on top.
Roast about 1 hour 15 minutes, until the thigh juices run clear (165°F / 74°C). Rest 10 minutes before carving.

recipes.name: Chicken Pot Pie
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Line a 9-inch pie plate with one crust.
Make the sauce: melt the butter, cook the onion 5 minutes, stir in the flour, then slowly whisk in the stock and milk. Simmer until thick and season with the thyme, salt and pepper.
Stir in the chicken and vegetables, pour into the crust and cover with the second crust. Crimp the edges and cut a few slits.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes until golden. Rest 10 minutes before slicing.

swaps.label: Use canned cream of chicken soup
swaps.note: Skip step 2: mix the soup with the milk and thyme, then carry on from step 3.

recipes.name: Honey Garlic Chicken Thighs
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Season the chicken and sear skin side down in an oven-safe pan for 6 minutes until crisp.
Make the sauce: stir the honey, soy sauce, garlic and vinegar together.
Flip the chicken, pour the sauce around it and roast 20 minutes, basting once, until cooked through.
Serve with rice and steamed broccoli, spooning the sauce over and topping with green onion.

swaps.label: Use bottled honey garlic sauce
swaps.note: Skip step 2 and pour the bottled sauce around the chicken in step 3.

recipes.name: Chicken Caesar Salad
steps: Season the chicken and cook in the oil, 6 minutes a side, until cooked through. Rest, then slice. Cook the bacon until crisp and crumble it.
Make the dressing: whisk the mayonnaise, juice of the lemon, mustard, grated garlic, anchovy paste, worcestershire and half the parmesan.
Toss the chopped romaine with the dressing, then top with the chicken, croutons, bacon and the rest of the parmesan.

swaps.label: Use bottled Caesar dressing
swaps.note: Skip step 2 and toss the romaine with bottled Caesar dressing.

recipes.name: Chicken and Vegetable Stir-Fry
steps: Cook the rice according to the package.
Make the sauce: whisk the soy sauce, oyster sauce, sugar, cornstarch and 1/2 cup water.
Stir-fry the chicken in 1 tbsp oil over high heat for 5 minutes until cooked. Set aside.
Stir-fry the vegetables in the rest of the oil for 4 minutes, adding the garlic and ginger for the last minute.
Return the chicken, pour in the sauce and toss until glossy and thick. Serve over rice.

swaps.label: Use bottled stir-fry sauce
swaps.note: Skip step 2 and pour in about 3/4 cup of bottled stir-fry sauce in step 5.

recipes.name: Ground Beef Tacos
steps: Brown the beef with the chopped onion in a skillet, breaking it up, about 8 minutes. Drain the fat.
Stir in the chili powder, cumin, paprika, garlic powder, oregano, 1 tsp salt and 2/3 cup water. Simmer 5 minutes until saucy.
Warm the taco shells and fill with the beef, lettuce, tomato, cheese, sour cream and salsa.

swaps.label: Use a taco seasoning packet
swaps.note: In step 2, stir in the seasoning packet with the water instead of the spices.

recipes.name: Chili con Carne
steps: Cook the chopped onion and pepper in the oil in a large pot for 5 minutes. Add the beef and brown it, breaking it up.
Stir in the garlic, chili powder, cumin, oregano and tomato paste for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, beans and stock. Simmer uncovered for 40 minutes, stirring now and then, until thick. Season with salt.
Serve topped with cheese and sour cream.

recipes.name: Classic Cheeseburgers
steps: Shape the beef into 4 patties a little wider than the buns, pressing a dimple in the middle of each. Season both sides well.
Grill or pan-fry over medium-high heat, 4 minutes a side, until 160°F (71°C) inside. Add the cheese for the last minute.
Toast the buns and build the burgers with lettuce, tomato, onion, pickles, ketchup and mustard.

recipes.name: Classic Meatloaf
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (180°C). Soak the breadcrumbs in the milk for 5 minutes.
Mix in the beef, onion, eggs, worcestershire, 1/4 cup of the ketchup, 1 1/2 tsp salt and some pepper with your hands, without overworking.
Shape into a loaf on a lined baking sheet. Stir the rest of the ketchup with the sugar and mustard and spread on top.
Bake about 1 hour, until 160°F (71°C) in the middle. Rest 10 minutes. Serve with mashed potatoes.

recipes.name: Shepherd's Pie
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Boil the potatoes in salted water until tender, then mash with the butter and milk. Season.
Brown the beef with the onion and carrots for 8 minutes. Stir in the tomato paste and flour for 1 minute.
Add the stock and worcestershire and simmer 10 minutes until thick. Stir in the peas.
Spread the filling in a baking dish, top with the mash and cheese, and bake 20 to 25 minutes until golden.

swaps.label: Use a gravy mix packet
swaps.note: In step 3, whisk the gravy mix with 1 cup of water and add it to the beef instead of the stock.

recipes.name: Beef Stew
steps: Toss the beef with the flour, salt and pepper. Brown in batches in the oil in a heavy pot. Set aside.
Cook the onion and celery 5 minutes, then the garlic and tomato paste 1 minute.
Return the beef, add the stock, thyme and bay leaves, cover and simmer 1 1/2 hours.
Add the potatoes and carrots and simmer 30 minutes more until tender. Stir in the peas for the last 5 minutes.

recipes.name: Beef and Bean Burritos
steps: Cook the rice according to the package.
Brown the beef with the onion, breaking it up. Stir in the chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, 1 tsp salt and 1/2 cup water and simmer 5 minutes.
Warm the tortillas. Spread each with refried beans, then add rice, beef, salsa and cheese.
Fold in the sides and roll up. Toast seam side down in a dry skillet for 2 minutes a side. Serve with sour cream.

swaps.label: Use a taco seasoning packet
swaps.note: In step 2, stir in the seasoning packet with the water instead of the spices.

recipes.name: Sloppy Joes
steps: Brown the beef with the chopped onion and pepper for 8 minutes. Drain the fat.
Make the sauce: stir in the ketchup, tomato sauce, sugar, mustard and worcestershire.
Simmer 10 minutes until thick. Spoon onto toasted buns.

swaps.label: Use canned sloppy joe sauce
swaps.note: In step 2, stir in the can of sloppy joe sauce instead.

recipes.name: Loaded Beef Nachos
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Brown the beef, then stir in the chili powder, cumin, salt and 1/3 cup water and simmer 3 minutes.
Spread half the chips on a lined sheet pan, top with half the beef, beans and cheese. Repeat.
Bake 10 minutes until the cheese melts. Top with tomato, jalapeños, green onion and avocado, and serve with sour cream and salsa.

swaps.label: Use a taco seasoning packet
swaps.note: In step 1, stir in the seasoning packet with the water instead of the spices.

recipes.name: Stuffed Peppers
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Cut the tops off the peppers, pull out the seeds and stand them in a baking dish.
Brown the beef with the onion and garlic. Stir in the rice, half the tomatoes, the seasoning and salt.
Fill the peppers, pour the rest of the tomatoes around them, cover with foil and bake 35 minutes.
Top with the mozzarella and bake uncovered 10 minutes more.

recipes.name: Steak with Garlic Butter

ingredients.name: steak
ingredients.measure: 2 striploins or ribeyes, about 2.5 cm (1 in) thick

steps: Take the steaks out 30 minutes ahead. Pat dry and season generously. Boil the potatoes and green beans while the steak cooks.
Sear in the oil in a very hot cast-iron pan, 3 to 4 minutes a side for medium-rare.
Add the butter, garlic and thyme, tilt the pan and spoon the foaming butter over the steaks for 1 minute.
Rest 5 minutes, slice and pour the butter over. Serve with the potatoes and beans.

recipes.name: Pulled Pork Sandwiches
steps: Rub the pork with the sugar, paprika, garlic powder and 2 tsp salt. Set on the onion in a slow cooker.
Make the barbecue sauce: whisk the ketchup, vinegar, molasses and worcestershire. Pour half over the pork.
Cook on low for 8 hours (or high for 5) until it falls apart.
Shred with two forks, toss with the juices and the rest of the sauce, and pile onto buns with coleslaw.

swaps.label: Use bottled BBQ sauce
swaps.note: Skip step 2: pour half the bottle of BBQ sauce over the pork, and toss the rest with it in step 4.

recipes.name: Oven-Baked BBQ Ribs
steps: Heat the oven to 275°F (135°C). Pull the thin membrane off the back of the ribs.
Mix the sugar, paprika, garlic and onion powder with 2 tsp salt and rub all over. Wrap each rack tightly in foil.
Bake 2 1/2 hours until tender.
Make the sauce: simmer the ketchup, vinegar, molasses and worcestershire for 5 minutes.
Unwrap, brush with sauce and broil or grill 5 minutes until sticky.

swaps.label: Use bottled BBQ sauce
swaps.note: Skip step 4 and brush the ribs with bottled BBQ sauce.

recipes.name: Pan-Fried Pork Chops
steps: Boil the potatoes until tender and mash with some of the butter. Steam the green beans.
Season the chops with the paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper.
Sear in the oil over medium-high heat, 4 to 5 minutes a side, until 145°F (63°C). Add the rest of the butter for the last minute and baste.
Rest 5 minutes and serve with the mash, beans and applesauce.

recipes.name: Sheet-Pan Sausage and Peppers
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Toss the potatoes, peppers and onion with the oil, seasoning and salt on a large sheet pan. Nestle in the sausages.
Roast 30 minutes, turning once, until the sausages are browned and cooked through.

recipes.photo: Liat Portal for Foodie Disorder - Salmon with garlic and herbs, crushed potatoes and peas.jpg
recipes.name: Garlic Butter Salmon
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Cook the rice according to the package.
Lay the salmon and asparagus on a lined sheet pan. Toss the asparagus with the oil and salt.
Mix the butter, garlic, juice of half the lemon and salt, and spoon over the salmon.
Bake 12 to 15 minutes until the salmon flakes. Top with parsley and lemon wedges.

recipes.name: Baked Fish and Chips
steps: Heat the oven to 450°F (230°C). Cut the potatoes into wedges, toss with 2 tbsp oil and salt and roast 20 minutes.
Dip the fish in flour, then beaten egg, then panko mixed with the paprika and salt. Drizzle with the rest of the oil.
Add the fish to the oven on a second pan, flip the potatoes, and bake 12 to 15 minutes until the fish flakes and the chips are crisp.
Serve with lemon wedges and tartar sauce.

recipes.name: Chicken Noodle Soup
steps: Cook the chopped onion, carrots and celery in the butter for 6 minutes. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the stock, chicken, thyme and bay leaf. Simmer 20 minutes, then lift out the chicken and shred it.
Add the noodles and cook until tender, about 7 minutes. Return the chicken, season and stir in the parsley.

recipes.name: Minestrone Soup
steps: Cook the onion, carrots and celery in the oil for 6 minutes. Add the zucchini and garlic for 2 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, stock, beans and seasoning and simmer 15 minutes.
Add the pasta and cook until tender. Stir in the spinach to wilt, season, and serve with parmesan.

recipes.photo: Broccoli cheddar soup and grilled cheese sandwich.jpg
recipes.name: Broccoli Cheddar Soup
steps: Melt the butter and cook the onion 5 minutes. Stir in the flour for 1 minute, then slowly whisk in the stock and milk.
Add the broccoli and carrot and simmer 15 minutes until tender.
Off the heat, stir in the cheddar a handful at a time until melted. Season and blend part of it if you like it smoother.

recipes.photo: Parmesan potato soup topped with bacon.jpg
recipes.name: Loaded Baked Potato Soup
steps: Cook the bacon in a pot until crisp. Crumble it and keep 1 tbsp fat in the pot.
Cook the onion in the fat 5 minutes. Add the potatoes and stock and simmer 15 minutes until soft.
Mash about half the potatoes in the pot, then stir in the milk, sour cream and 1 cup cheese. Season.
Serve topped with bacon, the rest of the cheese and green onion.

recipes.name: Chickpea Curry
steps: Cook the rice according to the package.
Make the curry base: cook the onion in the oil 6 minutes, then the garlic, ginger, curry powder, garam masala and cumin for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, coconut milk and chickpeas and simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until wilted, season, and serve over rice.

swaps.label: Use jarred curry sauce
swaps.note: In step 2, cook the onion, then add the jar of curry sauce with the chickpeas and simmer 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Grilled Cheese and Tomato Soup
steps: For the soup: cook the onion in 1 tbsp butter 5 minutes, add the tomatoes and stock and simmer 10 minutes. Blend smooth, stir in the cream and season.
Butter the outsides of the bread and fill with the cheese.
Cook in a skillet over medium-low heat, 3 to 4 minutes a side, until golden and melted. Serve with the soup for dipping.

swaps.label: Use canned tomato soup
swaps.note: Skip step 1 and heat the canned tomato soup with a can of milk or water.

recipes.name: Egg Fried Rice
steps: Scramble the eggs in 1 tbsp oil in a hot wok or skillet. Set aside.
Stir-fry the garlic, white parts of the green onion and the peas and carrots in the rest of the oil for 2 minutes.
Add the rice and stir-fry 4 minutes until hot. Add the soy sauce, sesame oil, eggs and green onion tops and toss.

recipes.name: French Toast
steps: Whisk the eggs, milk, cinnamon, vanilla and sugar in a shallow dish.
Dip each slice for a few seconds a side.
Cook in butter in a skillet over medium heat, 2 to 3 minutes a side, until golden. Serve with maple syrup and berries.

recipes.name: Breakfast Burritos
steps: Cook the bacon until crisp and crumble it. Cook the potatoes in the bacon fat for 10 minutes until golden.
Scramble the eggs gently in the butter and season.
Fill each warm tortilla with eggs, potatoes, bacon and cheese, roll up and toast seam side down. Serve with salsa.

recipes.name: Bacon and Egg Breakfast Sandwich
steps: Cook the bacon until crisp. Toast the english muffins.
Fry the eggs in the butter, breaking the yolks, and top each with a cheese slice for the last minute.
Stack the egg and bacon in the muffins.

recipes.name: Creamy Mashed Potatoes
steps: Peel and quarter the potatoes. Cover with cold salted water and simmer 15 to 20 minutes until a knife slides in easily.
Drain well and let steam dry for a minute.
Mash with the butter, then the warm milk, and season.

recipes.name: Garlic Bread
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Mix the butter, garlic, parsley, parmesan and salt.
Split the bread lengthwise and spread with the butter.
Bake 10 minutes, then broil 1 minute until golden. Slice.

recipes.name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Beat the butter and both sugars until fluffy. Beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking soda and salt, then the chocolate chips.
Scoop rounded tablespoons onto lined sheets, 2 inches apart. Bake 9 to 11 minutes until golden at the edges.

recipes.name: Banana Bread
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (180°C) and grease a 9x5 loaf pan.
Mash the bananas, then stir in the butter, sugar, egg and vanilla.
Stir in the baking soda and salt, then the flour and walnuts until just mixed.
Bake 55 to 65 minutes until a skewer comes out clean. Cool before slicing.

recipes.name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
steps: Boil the spaghetti in well-salted water until al dente. Save 1 cup of the cooking water, then drain.
While it cooks, warm the oil and garlic in a large pan over medium-low heat for 3 to 4 minutes, until the garlic is just golden. Add the pepper flakes.
Toss the spaghetti in the pan with a splash of the pasta water until glossy.
Stir in the parsley, season with salt, and serve with parmesan if you like.

recipes.name: Pasta Primavera
steps: Boil the penne in salted water. Add the broccoli and peas for the last 3 minutes, then drain, saving 1/2 cup of the water.
Meanwhile cook the zucchini and pepper in the oil over medium-high heat for 5 minutes. Add the garlic and tomatoes for 2 minutes more.
Stir in the butter, cream and half the parmesan, then the pasta, broccoli and peas, loosening with the pasta water.
Finish with the lemon zest and a squeeze of juice, the rest of the parmesan, salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Cacio e Pepe
steps: Boil the spaghetti in lightly salted water (the cheese is salty). Save 1 1/2 cups of the water before draining.
Toast the pepper in the butter in a large pan for 1 minute.
Off the heat, add the spaghetti and 1/2 cup of the water. Add the cheeses a handful at a time, tossing fast and adding water, until a smooth sauce coats the pasta. Serve right away.

recipes.name: American Goulash
steps: Brown the beef with the chopped onion and pepper in a large pot. Drain any fat and add the garlic for 1 minute.
Stir in the crushed tomatoes, tomato sauce, broth, paprika and Italian seasoning. Bring to a boil.
Add the macaroni, cover and simmer, stirring now and then, for 12 to 15 minutes until tender.
Season, then top with the cheddar and cover for 2 minutes to melt.

swaps.label: Use jarred pasta sauce
swaps.note: In step 2, pour in the jar of pasta sauce with the broth and paprika.

recipes.name: Baked Stuffed Shells
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Boil the shells until just tender, drain and rinse in cool water.
Make the sauce: cook the garlic in the oil for 1 minute, add the crushed tomatoes and basil, and simmer 10 minutes.
Mix the ricotta, spinach, egg, half the mozzarella, the parmesan and a pinch of salt.
Spread half the sauce in a 9x13 dish. Fill each shell with a spoonful of the filling and set them in the dish.
Spoon over the rest of the sauce, top with the remaining mozzarella, cover with foil and bake 25 minutes, then uncovered 10 more.

swaps.label: Use jarred pasta sauce
swaps.note: Skip step 2 and use the jar of pasta sauce instead.

recipes.name: Scrambled Eggs and Toast
steps: Whisk the eggs, milk and a pinch of salt.
Melt the butter in a non-stick pan over medium-low heat. Add the eggs and stir slowly with a spatula until softly set, about 3 minutes.
Take them off the heat while still a little wet. Serve on buttered toast with pepper and chives.

recipes.name: Blueberry Muffins
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a 12-cup muffin pan.
Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in a bowl. In another, whisk the eggs, milk, oil and vanilla.
Stir the wet into the dry until just mixed (a few lumps are fine), then fold in the blueberries.
Fill the cups, sprinkle with a little sugar and bake 18 to 22 minutes until golden.

recipes.name: Buttermilk Waffles
steps: Heat the waffle iron.
Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt. Whisk in the buttermilk, eggs and melted butter until just combined.
Pour batter into the greased iron and cook until golden and crisp, 4 to 5 minutes each.
Serve with maple syrup and sliced strawberries.

recipes.name: Eggs Benedict
steps: Make the hollandaise: whisk the 3 yolks with 1 tbsp lemon juice in a bowl set over simmering water until thick. Slowly whisk in the melted butter. Season and keep warm.
Brown the back bacon in a pan and toast the split muffins.
Bring a wide pot of water to a gentle simmer with the vinegar. Crack in the eggs and poach 3 minutes. Lift out with a slotted spoon.
Top each muffin half with bacon, an egg and hollandaise, and dust with paprika.

swaps.label: Use store-bought hollandaise
swaps.note: In step 1, use 3 eggs fewer and warm the store-bought hollandaise as the package says instead of making it.

recipes.name: Crispy Hash Browns
steps: Peel and coarsely grate the potatoes. Wrap them in a clean towel and squeeze out as much water as you can.
Mix in the onion, 1 tsp salt and some pepper.
Heat the oil and butter in a large non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Spread the potatoes in a thin layer and press down.
Cook without stirring for 6 to 8 minutes until deep golden, flip in sections, and cook 5 minutes more.

recipes.name: Quiche Lorraine
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Bake the pie shell 10 minutes.
Cook the chopped bacon until crisp, then soften the chopped onion in the fat for 5 minutes. Drain.
Whisk the eggs, cream, nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Scatter the bacon, onion and cheese in the shell, pour in the custard, and bake 30 to 35 minutes until just set in the middle. Rest 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Overnight Oats
steps: Stir the oats, milk, yogurt, chia, maple syrup and vanilla together in two jars.
Cover and chill overnight, or at least 4 hours.
Top with blueberries and sliced banana in the morning.

recipes.name: Crispy Roast Potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C) with the oil in a large roasting pan.
Cut the potatoes into chunks and boil in salted water for 8 minutes. Drain and shake in the pot to rough up the edges.
Tip them into the hot oil with the garlic and rosemary, turn to coat, and season.
Roast 40 to 45 minutes, turning once, until crisp and golden.

recipes.photo: Turkish Pilaf Rice - degustation - Ottoman Cuisine (3061206332).jpg
recipes.name: Rice Pilaf
steps: Melt the butter in a pot and toast the orzo until golden, about 3 minutes.
Add the chopped onion for 3 minutes, then the garlic and rice for 1 minute.
Pour in the broth, bring to a boil, cover and simmer on low for 18 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes off the heat, then fluff with a fork and stir in the parsley.

recipes.name: Cornbread
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and grease an 8-inch square pan or cast-iron skillet.
Whisk the cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder and salt. Stir in the milk, eggs and butter until just mixed.
Pour into the pan and bake 20 to 25 minutes until golden and a skewer comes out clean.

recipes.photo: Liat Portal for Foodie Disorder - Roasted broccoli cauliflower and onions.jpg
recipes.name: Garlic Parmesan Roasted Broccoli
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Toss the broccoli with the oil, garlic, salt and pepper on a baking sheet.
Roast 18 to 20 minutes until browned at the edges. Toss with the parmesan and a squeeze of lemon.

recipes.name: Greek Salad
steps: Cut the tomatoes into wedges, and the cucumber and pepper into chunks. Thinly slice the onion.
Toss with the olives, oil, vinegar and a pinch of salt.
Top with the feta, in a slab or crumbled, and sprinkle with oregano.

swaps.label: Use bottled Greek dressing
swaps.note: In step 2, toss the vegetables with the bottled dressing instead.

recipes.name: Pork Carnitas Tacos
steps: Heat the oven to 325°F (160°C). Put the pork in a Dutch oven with the quartered onion, garlic, cumin, oregano, salt, the orange juice and the juice of 1 lime.
Add water to come halfway up the meat. Cover and bake 2 1/2 hours until it falls apart.
Shred the pork, spread on a sheet pan with some of the juices, and broil 5 minutes until the edges crisp.
Serve in warm tortillas with chopped onion, cilantro, salsa and lime wedges.

recipes.photo: Seared and roasted Pork Tenderloin in Cast Iron Skillet.jpg
recipes.name: Roast Pork Tenderloin
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Season the pork with salt and pepper.
Brown it all over in the oil in an ovenproof pan, about 5 minutes.
Mix the mustard, honey, garlic and rosemary and brush it over the pork.
Roast 15 to 20 minutes until it reaches 145°F (63°C). Rest 5 minutes before slicing.

recipes.name: Scalloped Potatoes and Ham
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C) and butter a 9x13 dish. Thinly slice the potatoes and onion.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour for 1 minute, then whisk in the milk and simmer until thickened. Season and stir in 1 cup of the cheddar.
Layer the potatoes, onion and ham in the dish, pouring sauce over each layer.
Cover with foil and bake 45 minutes. Uncover, top with the rest of the cheddar and bake 25 minutes more until tender and golden.

recipes.name: Sausages and Mash with Onion Gravy
steps: Boil the peeled, chunked potatoes in salted water until tender, 15 to 20 minutes. Drain and mash with 2 tbsp butter and the milk.
Meanwhile brown the sausages in a pan over medium heat, turning, for 15 minutes until cooked through. Set aside.
Make the gravy: cook the sliced onions in the rest of the butter for 10 minutes until golden. Stir in the flour, then the broth, and simmer until thick.
Cook the peas, then serve the sausages on the mash with the gravy and peas.

swaps.label: Use gravy mix
swaps.note: In step 3, cook the onions, then make the gravy mix with water as the packet says and stir it in.

recipes.name: Eggplant Parmesan
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Slice the eggplant into rounds 1 cm thick and salt them for 20 minutes, then pat dry.
Dip the slices in beaten egg, then in the breadcrumbs mixed with half the parmesan. Lay on oiled sheets, drizzle with oil and bake 25 minutes, turning once.
Make the sauce: cook the garlic in 1 tbsp oil, add the crushed tomatoes and basil, and simmer 10 minutes.
Layer sauce, eggplant, mozzarella and parmesan in a 9x13 dish, twice. Bake 25 minutes until bubbling.

swaps.label: Use jarred pasta sauce
swaps.note: Skip step 3 and layer with the jar of pasta sauce instead.

recipes.name: Crispy Black Bean Tacos
steps: Mash the beans roughly with the taco seasoning and 2 tbsp water.
Spread a spoonful on half of each tortilla, top with cheese and fold.
Fry the tacos in a little oil over medium heat, 2 to 3 minutes a side, until crisp.
Mash the avocado with lime and salt. Fill the tacos with cabbage, avocado, sour cream and salsa.

recipes.name: Vegetable Lasagna
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
Make the sauce: cook half the garlic in 1 tbsp oil, add the crushed tomatoes and oregano, and simmer 15 minutes.
Cook the chopped zucchini, mushrooms and pepper in the rest of the oil with the remaining garlic for 8 minutes. Wilt in the spinach.
Mix the ricotta, egg and half the parmesan.
In a 9x13 dish layer sauce, noodles, ricotta, vegetables and mozzarella three times, ending with sauce, mozzarella and parmesan.
Cover and bake 40 minutes, then uncover for 15. Rest 15 minutes before cutting.

swaps.label: Use jarred pasta sauce
swaps.note: Skip step 2 and layer with the jarred pasta sauce instead.

recipes.name: Baked Salmon Tacos
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Rub the salmon with the oil, chili powder, cumin and salt.
Bake 12 to 14 minutes until it flakes, then break into pieces.
Stir the mayonnaise with the sriracha and the juice of 1 lime. Toss the cabbage with a little of it.
Fill warm tortillas with cabbage, salmon, avocado, cilantro and the rest of the sauce. Serve with lime wedges.

recipes.name: Shrimp Fried Rice
steps: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok or large pan over high heat. Cook the shrimp 2 minutes a side and set aside.
Scramble the eggs in another tbsp of oil, then set aside.
Add the rest of the oil, the garlic, peas and carrots for 2 minutes, then the rice. Stir-fry 4 minutes until hot and a little crisp.
Stir in the soy sauce, sesame oil, shrimp, eggs and sliced green onions.

recipes.name: Chicken Fettuccine Alfredo
steps: Boil the fettuccine in salted water until al dente. Save 1/2 cup of the water and drain.
Season the chicken and cook in 1 tbsp of the butter, 6 minutes a side, until cooked through. Rest, then slice.
Melt the rest of the butter in the same pan, cook the garlic for 30 seconds, then add the cream and simmer 3 minutes.
Take off the heat, stir in the parmesan until smooth, then toss in the pasta with a splash of the pasta water.
Top with the chicken, pepper and chopped parsley.

swaps.label: Use jarred Alfredo sauce
swaps.note: Use the alfredo sauce in place of the butter, heavy cream and parmesan.

recipes.name: Creamy Tuscan Chicken Pasta
steps: Boil the penne in salted water until al dente, then drain.
Season the chicken with salt and the Italian seasoning and cook in the oil, 6 minutes a side. Rest, then slice.
In the same pan cook the garlic and sun-dried tomatoes for 1 minute. Pour in the cream and simmer 3 minutes.
Stir in the parmesan and spinach until the spinach wilts, then toss in the pasta and chicken.

recipes.name: One-Pot Taco Pasta
steps: Brown the beef with the chopped onion in a large pot, breaking it up. Drain the fat.
Stir in the taco seasoning, salsa and broth and bring to a boil.
Add the pasta, cover and simmer 10 to 12 minutes, stirring now and then, until tender.
Stir in half the cheese, top with the rest and cover 2 minutes to melt. Serve with sour cream and green onion.

recipes.name: Cheeseburger Macaroni
steps: Brown the beef with the chopped onion in a large pan. Drain the fat.
Stir in the paprika, ketchup and mustard, then the broth, milk and macaroni. Bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer 10 to 12 minutes, stirring often, until the pasta is tender.
Take off the heat and stir in the cheddar until melted. Season.

recipes.name: Chicken Tetrazzini
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Boil the spaghetti 2 minutes less than the package says and drain.
Melt the butter, cook the onion and mushrooms 6 minutes, then stir in the flour for 1 minute.
Slowly whisk in the stock and milk and simmer until thick. Stir in half the parmesan and season.
Mix in the spaghetti, chicken and peas, spread in a baking dish, top with the rest of the parmesan and bake 25 minutes.

swaps.label: Use cream of mushroom soup
swaps.note: Use the cream of mushroom soup in place of the mushrooms, butter and flour.

recipes.name: Baked Spaghetti
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Boil the spaghetti until just shy of al dente and drain.
Brown the beef with the onion and garlic. Add the tomatoes and oregano and simmer 10 minutes.
Toss the spaghetti with the sauce and spread in a 9x13 dish.
Top with the mozzarella and parmesan and bake 25 minutes until bubbling and golden.

swaps.label: Use jarred pasta sauce
swaps.note: Use the pasta sauce in place of the crushed tomatoes and dried oregano.

recipes.name: Creamy Mushroom Pasta
steps: Boil the linguine in salted water until al dente. Save 1 cup of the water and drain.
Brown the mushrooms in the butter over high heat for 8 minutes. Add the garlic and thyme for 1 minute.
Pour in the cream and simmer 3 minutes, then stir in the parmesan.
Toss with the pasta and splashes of pasta water until glossy. Finish with parsley and pepper.

recipes.name: Spaghetti Puttanesca
steps: Boil the spaghetti in salted water until al dente and drain.
Warm the oil with the garlic, anchovies and chili flakes, mashing the anchovies, for 2 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, olives and capers and simmer 10 minutes.
Toss with the spaghetti and parsley.

recipes.name: Tortellini with Sausage and Spinach
steps: Boil the tortellini according to the package and drain.
Brown the sausage in a large pan, breaking it up. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Stir in the tomatoes and cream and simmer 5 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until wilted, then the tortellini and parmesan.

swaps.label: Use jarred pasta sauce
swaps.note: Use the pasta sauce in place of the crushed tomatoes.

recipes.name: Gnocchi with Brown Butter and Sage
steps: Boil the gnocchi until they float, about 2 minutes. Drain.
Melt the butter in a large pan over medium heat until it foams and smells nutty, about 3 minutes. Add the sage for 30 seconds.
Add the gnocchi and fry 3 minutes until golden in spots.
Squeeze over a little lemon and toss with the parmesan and pepper.

recipes.name: Lemon Ricotta Pasta with Peas
steps: Boil the pasta in salted water. Add the peas for the last 2 minutes. Save 1 cup of the water and drain.
Mix the ricotta, parmesan, the zest and juice of the lemon, salt and lots of pepper.
Toss the pasta and peas with the ricotta mixture, loosening with pasta water until creamy.
Tear over the basil.

recipes.name: Chicken Cacciatore
steps: Season the chicken and brown skin side down in the oil in a large pot, 6 minutes. Turn and brown 2 minutes. Set aside.
Cook the sliced onion, peppers and mushrooms in the same pot 8 minutes. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Stir in the tomatoes and oregano, nestle in the chicken, cover and simmer 30 minutes until cooked through.
Serve with pasta, rice or crusty bread.

swaps.label: Use jarred pasta sauce
swaps.note: Use the pasta sauce in place of the crushed tomatoes and dried oregano.

recipes.name: Chicken Marsala
steps: Season the cutlets and dredge in flour. Brown in the oil and 1 tbsp butter, 3 minutes a side. Set aside.
Cook the mushrooms in the same pan 5 minutes until browned.
Add the marsala and stock, scraping the pan, and simmer 5 minutes until reduced by half.
Stir in the rest of the butter, return the chicken and simmer 2 minutes. Top with parsley.

recipes.name: Chicken Piccata
steps: Season the cutlets and dredge in flour. Brown in the oil, 3 minutes a side. Set aside.
Add the stock, the juice of the lemons and the capers to the pan and simmer 3 minutes.
Swirl in the butter until glossy, return the chicken and spoon over the sauce.
Top with parsley and serve with pasta or mashed potatoes.

recipes.name: Buffalo Chicken Wraps
steps: Season the chicken and cook in a skillet, 6 minutes a side, until cooked through. Slice.
Melt the butter with the hot sauce and toss with the chicken.
Lay out the tortillas and fill with shredded lettuce, diced tomato, cheese, the chicken and ranch.
Roll up tightly and toast seam side down in a dry pan for 2 minutes a side.

recipes.name: Baked BBQ Chicken Drumsticks
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Toss the drumsticks with the oil, paprika, garlic powder, sugar and 1 tsp salt.
Bake on a lined sheet pan for 30 minutes, turning once.
Brush with the BBQ sauce and bake 10 to 15 minutes more until sticky and cooked through.

recipes.name: Chicken Souvlaki with Tzatziki
steps: Mix the chicken with the juice of 1 lemon, the oil, 2 grated garlic cloves, oregano and 1 tsp salt. Leave 20 minutes.
For the tzatziki, grate the cucumber, squeeze it dry and mix with the yogurt, the last garlic clove and a squeeze of lemon.
Thread the chicken onto skewers and grill or broil 10 to 12 minutes, turning, until cooked through.
Serve in warm pitas with tzatziki, tomato and onion.

recipes.name: Chicken Tikka Masala
steps: Toss the chicken with the yogurt, half the garam masala, the cumin and 1 tsp salt. Leave 15 minutes.
Cook the rice. Broil the chicken on a sheet pan 10 minutes until charred at the edges.
Cook the onion in the oil 6 minutes, then the garlic, ginger and the rest of the garam masala for 1 minute. Add the tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in the cream and chicken and simmer 5 minutes. Serve over rice with cilantro.

swaps.label: Use jarred tikka masala sauce
swaps.note: Use the tikka masala sauce in place of the onion, garlic, ginger, crushed tomatoes and heavy cream.

recipes.name: Chicken Enchiladas
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Spread a little of the sauce in a 9x13 dish.
Mix the chicken, beans, 1 cup of the cheese and 1/2 cup of the sauce.
Fill each tortilla, roll up and set seam side down in the dish.
Pour over the rest of the sauce, top with the cheese and bake 20 minutes. Serve with sour cream and green onion.

recipes.name: Crispy Baked Chicken Tenders
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C) and line a sheet pan with parchment.
Season the strips. Dip in flour, then beaten egg, then the panko mixed with parmesan, paprika and garlic powder.
Lay on the pan, drizzle with oil and bake 18 to 20 minutes, turning once, until golden and cooked through.
Serve with honey mustard.

recipes.name: Chicken and Sausage Jambalaya
steps: Brown the sausage and chicken in the oil in a large pot. Set aside.
Cook the onion, pepper and celery 6 minutes, then the garlic and Cajun seasoning for 1 minute.
Stir in the rice, tomatoes, stock, chicken and sausage. Bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer on low for 20 to 25 minutes until the rice is tender. Rest 5 minutes and fluff.

recipes.name: Cashew Chicken
steps: Cook the rice. Toss the chicken with 1 tbsp soy sauce and the cornstarch.
Stir-fry the chicken in 1 tbsp oil over high heat for 5 minutes. Set aside.
Stir-fry the broccoli and pepper in the rest of the oil 4 minutes, adding the garlic for the last minute.
Return the chicken with the rest of the soy sauce, the hoisin and 1/4 cup water. Toss until glossy, add the cashews and serve over rice.

recipes.name: Baked Chicken Cordon Bleu
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Butterfly each breast and pound to an even thickness.
Lay a slice of ham and cheese on each, roll up and secure with toothpicks.
Season, dip in flour, then egg, then panko. Set in a baking dish and drizzle with the butter.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes until golden and cooked through. Remove the toothpicks before serving.

recipes.name: Chicken Satay with Peanut Sauce
steps: Mix the chicken with 2 tbsp soy sauce, the sugar, curry powder and 1 grated garlic clove. Leave 20 minutes.
For the sauce, simmer the peanut butter, half the coconut milk, the rest of the soy sauce, the other garlic clove and the juice of the lime for 3 minutes.
Thread the chicken onto skewers and grill or broil 8 to 10 minutes, turning, until charred and cooked.
Serve with rice, sliced cucumber and the peanut sauce.

recipes.name: Lemon Pepper Chicken Wings
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Pat the wings dry and toss with the baking powder and 1 tsp salt.
Bake on a rack over a sheet pan for 45 minutes, turning once, until crisp.
Melt the butter with the zest and juice of the lemons, the pepper and garlic powder.
Toss the wings in the lemon pepper butter and serve.

recipes.name: Korean Ground Beef Bowls
steps: Cook the rice.
Brown the beef in a large pan, breaking it up, then drain the fat.
Stir in the garlic and ginger for 1 minute, then the soy sauce, brown sugar and sesame oil. Simmer 2 minutes until glossy.
Serve over the rice with sliced cucumber, green onions and sesame seeds.

swaps.label: Use bottled Korean BBQ sauce
swaps.note: Use the korean bbq sauce in place of the soy sauce, brown sugar and sesame oil.

recipes.name: Mongolian Beef
steps: Cook the rice. Slice the steak thinly across the grain and toss it in the cornstarch.
Fry the steak in the oil in batches over high heat, 2 minutes a batch, until browned. Set aside.
Cook the garlic and ginger in the same pan for 30 seconds, then add the soy sauce, sugar and water and simmer 3 minutes until it thickens.
Return the beef with the green onions cut in 5 cm lengths and toss for 1 minute. Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Swedish Meatballs
steps: Soak the breadcrumbs in the milk for 5 minutes, then mix in the beef, pork, egg, onion, allspice and 1 tsp salt. Roll into 30 small balls.
Brown the meatballs in 1 tbsp butter in batches, about 8 minutes, until cooked through. Set aside.
Melt the rest of the butter, whisk in the flour for 1 minute, then the broth. Simmer until thick, then stir in the sour cream.
Return the meatballs to the gravy and warm through. Serve over buttered egg noodles.

swaps.label: Use a gravy mix
swaps.note: Use the gravy mix in place of the butter, flour and beef broth.

recipes.name: Salisbury Steak with Mushroom Gravy
steps: Mix the beef, breadcrumbs, egg, Worcestershire, salt and pepper and shape into 4 oval patties.
Brown the patties in a large pan, 4 minutes a side, then set aside.
Cook the sliced onion and mushrooms in the butter for 6 minutes. Stir in the flour, then the broth, and simmer until thick.
Return the patties to the gravy, cover and simmer 10 minutes. Serve with mashed potatoes.

swaps.label: Use a gravy mix
swaps.note: Use the gravy mix in place of the flour and beef broth.

recipes.name: Philly Cheesesteak Sandwiches
steps: Freeze the steak for 30 minutes so it slices easily, then shave it as thinly as you can.
Cook the sliced onion, pepper and mushrooms in 1 tbsp oil until soft, about 8 minutes. Set aside.
Sear the steak in the rest of the oil over high heat for 2 minutes, season, and mix with the vegetables.
Split into 4 piles, top each with 2 slices of provolone until melted, then scoop into the toasted rolls.

recipes.name: Ground Beef Enchiladas
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Simmer the tomato sauce, chili powder and cumin for 5 minutes to make the sauce.
Brown the beef with the onion, drain, then stir in the beans, taco seasoning and 1/2 cup of the sauce.
Roll the filling and half the cheese in the tortillas and lay them seam down in a baking dish.
Pour over the rest of the sauce, top with the remaining cheese and bake 20 minutes. Serve with sour cream.

swaps.label: Use canned enchilada sauce
swaps.note: Use the enchilada sauce in place of the tomato sauce, chili powder and cumin.

recipes.name: Cabbage Roll Casserole
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Brown the beef with the onion and garlic, drain and season.
Stir in the rice, tomato sauce, broth and paprika.
Layer half the cabbage in a large baking dish, then half the beef, then the rest of each.
Cover with foil and bake 60 minutes until the rice is tender. Top with the cheese and bake 5 more minutes uncovered.

recipes.name: Crispy Ginger Beef
steps: Cook the rice. Slice the beef into thin strips, toss with the egg, then the cornstarch.
Fry in 2 cm of hot oil in batches until crisp, 3 minutes a batch. Drain on paper towel.
Pour off most of the oil and stir-fry the carrot, pepper, ginger and garlic for 2 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and chili flakes and boil 1 minute until syrupy. Toss in the beef and serve over rice.

swaps.label: Use bottled ginger sauce
swaps.note: Use the ginger sauce in place of the soy sauce, rice vinegar, brown sugar and chili flakes.

recipes.name: Steak Fajitas
steps: Rub the steak with the chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, 1 tsp salt and the juice of half the lime.
Sear in 1 tbsp oil over high heat, 4 minutes a side for medium. Rest 5 minutes, then slice thinly across the grain.
Cook the sliced peppers and onion in the rest of the oil over high heat until charred, about 6 minutes.
Serve the steak and vegetables in warm tortillas with sour cream, salsa and lime wedges.

swaps.label: Use a fajita seasoning packet
swaps.note: Use the fajita seasoning in place of the chili powder, cumin and garlic powder.

recipes.name: Meatball Subs
steps: Mix the beef, breadcrumbs, egg, parmesan, 1 grated garlic clove and 1 tsp salt. Roll into 16 balls.
Brown the meatballs in the oil for 6 minutes, turning.
Add the rest of the garlic for 30 seconds, then the tomatoes and oregano. Cover and simmer 15 minutes.
Spoon 4 meatballs and sauce into each roll, top with mozzarella and broil 2 minutes until melted.

swaps.label: Use jarred pasta sauce
swaps.note: Use the pasta sauce in place of the crushed tomatoes and dried oregano.

recipes.name: Steak Sandwiches with Caramelized Onions
steps: Cook the sliced onions in the butter over medium-low heat, stirring, for 20 minutes until golden.
Season the steak and sear it in a hot pan, 4 minutes a side for medium. Rest 5 minutes, then slice thinly.
Mix the mayonnaise and mustard and spread it on the toasted buns.
Fill with arugula, steak and onions.

recipes.name: Pork Souvlaki Pitas
steps: Toss the pork with the oil, lemon juice, 2 grated garlic cloves, the oregano and 1 tsp salt. Leave 20 minutes or overnight.
For the tzatziki, mix the yogurt with the grated, squeezed cucumber, the last garlic clove and a pinch of salt.
Thread onto skewers and grill or broil 10 to 12 minutes, turning, until cooked through.
Serve in warm pitas with tzatziki, tomato and sliced red onion.

swaps.label: Use store-bought tzatziki
swaps.note: Use the tzatziki in place of the greek yogurt and cucumber.

recipes.name: Honey Garlic Pork Chops
steps: Season the chops and sear in the oil over medium-high heat, 4 to 5 minutes a side, until 145°F (63°C) inside. Set aside.
Melt the butter in the same pan and cook the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the honey and soy sauce and simmer 2 minutes until sticky. Return the chops and turn to coat.
Serve with steamed green beans.

swaps.label: Use bottled honey garlic sauce
swaps.note: Use the honey garlic sauce in place of the honey and soy sauce.

recipes.name: Pork Schnitzel
steps: Pound the cutlets to 5 mm thick between plastic wrap and season with salt.
Coat each in flour, then beaten egg, then breadcrumbs.
Fry in 1 cm of hot oil, 2 to 3 minutes a side, until golden. Drain on paper towel.
Serve with lemon wedges and boiled potatoes.

recipes.name: Pork Fried Rice
steps: Stir-fry the pork in 1 tbsp oil over high heat until browned, 4 minutes. Set aside.
Scramble the eggs in the pan, then set aside with the pork.
Add the rest of the oil, the garlic and the peas and carrots for 2 minutes, then the rice. Fry 3 minutes, pressing it flat.
Stir in the soy sauce, sesame oil, pork, egg and green onions.

recipes.name: Peameal Bacon Sandwiches
steps: Fry the peameal bacon slices in a lightly oiled pan, 2 to 3 minutes a side, until golden at the edges.
Toast the buns cut side down in the same pan.
Spread the buns with honey mustard.
Pile on the bacon with lettuce and sliced tomato.

recipes.name: Pork and Broccoli Stir-Fry
steps: Cook the rice. Slice the pork thinly and toss with 1 tbsp soy sauce and the cornstarch.
Stir-fry the pork in 1 tbsp oil over high heat until browned, 3 minutes. Set aside.
Stir-fry the broccoli in the rest of the oil with 3 tbsp water for 3 minutes, then the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Return the pork with the oyster sauce, the rest of the soy sauce and 1/4 cup water and toss until glossy. Serve over rice.

swaps.label: Use a bottled stir-fry sauce
swaps.note: Use the stir fry sauce in place of the oyster sauce.

recipes.name: Brown Sugar Glazed Ham
steps: Heat the oven to 325°F (160°C). Score the ham in a diamond pattern and set it cut side down in a roasting pan with 1 cup water.
Cover with foil and bake 15 minutes a pound, about 2 hours, until 120°F (50°C) inside.
Simmer the sugar, mustard, honey, orange juice and cloves for 3 minutes.
Brush half the glaze over, raise the oven to 400°F (200°C) and bake 20 minutes uncovered, brushing with the rest halfway.

recipes.name: Apple Stuffed Pork Loin
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Cook the diced apple, onion and celery in the butter for 6 minutes. Stir in the bread, sage and broth.
Butterfly the pork so it opens like a book, season it, spread over the stuffing and roll it up. Tie with string every 5 cm.
Roast 60 to 75 minutes until 145°F (63°C) in the centre.
Rest 10 minutes, then slice.

swaps.label: Use a boxed stuffing mix
swaps.note: Use the stuffing mix in place of the bread cubes, dried sage, chicken broth and celery.

recipes.name: Baked Lemon Dill Cod
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Lay the cod and asparagus on a lined sheet pan and season.
Melt the butter with the garlic, lemon zest, half the lemon juice and the dill.
Spoon the butter over the fish and asparagus.
Bake 12 to 15 minutes until the fish flakes. Squeeze over the rest of the lemon.

recipes.name: Maple Glazed Salmon
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and cook the rice.
Whisk the maple syrup, soy sauce, mustard and grated garlic.
Lay the salmon on a lined pan, spoon over half the glaze and bake 12 to 15 minutes, brushing with the rest halfway.
Serve with the rice and steamed broccoli.

recipes.name: Crab Cakes
steps: Gently mix the crab, mayonnaise, egg, mustard, Old Bay, crackers and sliced green onions without breaking up the crab.
Shape into 8 cakes and chill 15 minutes so they hold together.
Fry in the butter over medium heat, 3 to 4 minutes a side, until golden.
Serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.name: Baked Coconut Shrimp
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C) and grease a sheet pan.
Season the flour. Beat the eggs. Mix the coconut and panko.
Coat each shrimp in flour, then egg, then the coconut mix, and lay them on the pan.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes, turning once, until golden. Serve with sweet chili sauce.

recipes.name: Tuna Melts
steps: Mix the tuna, mayonnaise, diced celery, onion and a squeeze of lemon.
Butter the bread on one side.
Build sandwiches buttered side out with a slice of cheese, the tuna and another slice of cheese.
Cook in a pan over medium-low heat, 3 to 4 minutes a side, until golden and melted.

recipes.name: Shrimp Tacos with Lime Slaw
steps: Toss the coleslaw with the mayonnaise, the juice of 1 lime and a pinch of salt.
Toss the shrimp with the chili powder, garlic powder and a pinch of salt.
Sear the shrimp in the oil over high heat, 1 to 2 minutes a side, until pink.
Fill warm tortillas with slaw, shrimp, avocado and cilantro, with lime wedges.

recipes.name: Salmon Potato Fish Cakes
steps: Boil the peeled potatoes until tender, drain and mash.
Mix in the salmon, sliced green onions, egg, mustard and some salt. Shape into 8 cakes.
Coat in breadcrumbs and chill 10 minutes.
Fry in the oil over medium heat, 4 minutes a side, until crisp. Serve with lemon.

recipes.name: Salmon Burgers
steps: Chop a quarter of the salmon very finely and the rest into small pieces.
Mix with the panko, egg, mustard, lemon zest, sliced green onions and a pinch of salt. Shape into 4 patties.
Fry in a little oil over medium heat, 4 minutes a side.
Serve in toasted buns with tartar sauce and lettuce.

recipes.name: Cajun Shrimp and Rice Skillet
steps: Brown the sausage in a deep pan for 3 minutes.
Add the onion, pepper and celery and cook 5 minutes, then the garlic and Cajun seasoning for 30 seconds.
Stir in the rice, broth and tomatoes. Cover and simmer 18 minutes.
Tuck in the shrimp, cover and cook 5 more minutes until pink.

recipes.name: Salmon Poke Bowls
steps: Cook the rice and season it with the vinegar while warm.
Cube the salmon and toss with the soy sauce, sesame oil and green onions.
Cook the edamame for 3 minutes and cool.
Build bowls with rice, salmon, cucumber, avocado and edamame, and top with sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Mussels in White Wine and Garlic
steps: Rinse the mussels and throw away any that are cracked or stay open when tapped.
Melt the butter in a large pot and cook the shallots and garlic for 2 minutes.
Add the wine, bring to a boil, add the mussels, cover and steam 5 to 6 minutes, shaking the pot, until they open.
Throw away any that stay shut. Scatter with parsley and serve with bread for the broth.

recipes.name: Crispy Tofu Stir-Fry
steps: Cook the rice. Press the tofu dry, cut it in cubes and toss with the cornstarch.
Fry the tofu in 2 tbsp oil until crisp on all sides, 8 minutes. Set aside.
Stir-fry the vegetables in the rest of the oil for 4 minutes, then the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the soy sauce, maple syrup and vinegar, return the tofu and toss. Serve over rice.

swaps.label: Use a bottled stir-fry sauce
swaps.note: Use the stir fry sauce in place of the soy sauce, maple syrup and rice vinegar.

recipes.name: Black Bean Burgers
steps: Pat the beans dry and mash them roughly, leaving some whole.
Mix in the breadcrumbs, egg, grated onion, garlic, cumin, chili powder and a pinch of salt. Shape into 4 patties.
Fry in a little oil over medium heat, 5 minutes a side, adding the cheese for the last minute.
Serve in toasted buns with sliced avocado.

recipes.name: Mushroom Risotto
steps: Brown the mushrooms in the oil and 1 tbsp butter, 6 minutes. Set aside.
Cook the onion in 1 tbsp butter for 4 minutes, then the garlic and rice for 1 minute. Add the wine and stir until absorbed.
Add the broth a ladle at a time, stirring, waiting until each is absorbed, for about 20 minutes until creamy.
Stir in the mushrooms, the rest of the butter and the parmesan.

recipes.name: Coconut Vegetable Curry
steps: Cook the rice. Cook the onion in a little oil for 5 minutes, then the garlic, ginger and curry powder for 1 minute.
Add the cubed sweet potato, cauliflower florets, tomatoes and coconut milk. Simmer 20 minutes until tender.
Stir in the chickpeas and spinach until the spinach wilts.
Season and serve over rice.

swaps.label: Use a jarred curry sauce
swaps.note: Use the curry sauce in place of the curry powder, coconut milk and diced tomatoes.

recipes.name: Roasted Cauliflower Tacos
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Toss small cauliflower florets with the oil, spices and 1 tsp salt.
Roast 25 minutes, turning once, until browned at the edges.
Mix the sour cream with the juice of half the lime.
Fill the tortillas with slaw, cauliflower, lime crema and cilantro.

recipes.name: Sweet Potato Black Bean Chili
steps: Cook the onion and pepper in a little oil for 5 minutes, then the garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add the peeled, cubed sweet potatoes, tomatoes and broth. Simmer 20 minutes.
Add the beans and simmer 10 more minutes until thick.
Season and finish with the lime juice.

recipes.name: Homemade Veggie Pizza
steps: Heat the oven to 475°F (245°C) with a sheet pan inside.
Stretch the dough into a large round on floured parchment.
Spread the sauce, then the cheese, then the vegetables and oregano.
Slide onto the hot pan and bake 12 to 15 minutes until browned and bubbling.

recipes.name: Bean and Cheese Enchiladas
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Simmer the tomato sauce, chili powder and cumin for 5 minutes.
Mix the refried beans, black beans, corn and 1 cup of the cheese.
Roll the filling in the tortillas and lay them seam down in a baking dish.
Pour over the sauce, top with the rest of the cheese and bake 20 minutes. Scatter with green onions.

swaps.label: Use canned enchilada sauce
swaps.note: Use the enchilada sauce in place of the tomato sauce, chili powder and cumin.

recipes.name: Mushroom Stroganoff
steps: Boil the noodles until tender and drain.
Brown the mushrooms in the butter over high heat, 8 minutes, then add the onion for 4 minutes and the garlic for 1.
Stir in the flour, then the broth, and simmer 5 minutes until thick.
Off the heat, stir in the sour cream and mustard. Serve over the noodles with parsley.

recipes.name: Zucchini Fritters
steps: Grate the zucchini, toss with 1 tsp salt and leave 10 minutes. Squeeze out as much water as you can.
Mix with the egg, flour, feta, sliced green onions and grated garlic.
Fry spoonfuls in the oil, flattened, 3 minutes a side until golden.
Serve with yogurt.

recipes.name: Pasta e Fagioli
steps: Brown the beef in a large pot and drain, if using.
Add the diced onion, carrots and celery and cook 6 minutes, then the garlic and Italian seasoning for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, beans and broth and simmer 15 minutes.
Add the pasta and simmer 10 minutes until tender. Serve with parmesan.

recipes.name: Hearty Lentil Soup
steps: Cook the diced onion, carrots and celery in the oil for 6 minutes, then the garlic and cumin for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, tomatoes and broth. Simmer 30 minutes until the lentils are soft.
Stir in the spinach until wilted.
Season and finish with the lemon juice.

recipes.name: Butternut Squash Soup
steps: Peel, seed and cube the squash. Peel and chop the apple.
Cook the onion in the butter for 5 minutes, then the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the squash, apple, broth and nutmeg and simmer 25 minutes until very soft.
Blend until smooth, stir in the cream and season.

recipes.name: Chicken Tortilla Soup
steps: Cook the onion and jalapeño in a little oil for 5 minutes, then the garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and broth, then the whole chicken breasts. Simmer 20 minutes until cooked.
Lift out the chicken, shred it and return it with the beans and corn. Simmer 5 minutes.
Serve with crushed tortilla chips, avocado and lime.

recipes.name: Beef Barley Soup
steps: Brown the beef in a little oil in batches, then set aside.
Cook the diced onion, carrots and celery for 6 minutes, then the garlic and tomato paste for 1 minute.
Return the beef with the broth, thyme and bay leaf. Simmer covered 45 minutes.
Add the barley and simmer 30 more minutes until tender. Remove the bay leaf.

recipes.name: Cream of Mushroom Soup
steps: Cook the mushrooms and onion in the butter over medium-high heat, 10 minutes, until browned.
Add the garlic and thyme for 1 minute, then stir in the flour.
Whisk in the broth and simmer 15 minutes.
Blend half the soup and stir it back in. Add the cream and season.

recipes.name: Hamburger Soup
steps: Brown the beef with the onion in a large pot and drain.
Add the diced carrots, celery and potatoes, the tomatoes, broth, Worcestershire and thyme.
Simmer 25 minutes until the potatoes are tender.
Add the green beans for 5 minutes and season.

recipes.name: Maritime Seafood Chowder
steps: Cook the chopped bacon until crisp, then the onion and celery in the fat for 5 minutes.
Stir in the butter and flour, then the stock and diced potatoes. Simmer 15 minutes until tender.
Add the milk and cream and bring just to a simmer.
Add the haddock, shrimp and scallops and cook gently 5 minutes until just done.

recipes.name: Italian Wedding Soup
steps: Mix the beef, breadcrumbs, egg, half the parmesan and a pinch of salt. Roll into small 2 cm balls.
Cook the onion and carrots in a little oil for 5 minutes, then add the broth and bring to a boil.
Drop in the meatballs and pasta and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in the spinach and serve with the rest of the parmesan.

recipes.name: Chicken and Dumplings

ingredients.name: flour
ingredients.measure: 1/4 cup, plus 2 cups for the dumplings

steps: Cook the onion, carrots and celery in the butter for 6 minutes. Stir in 1/4 cup flour, then the broth and thyme.
Add the chicken and simmer 20 minutes. Lift it out, shred it and return it.
Mix 2 cups flour, the baking powder and 1 tsp salt, then stir in the milk to a soft dough.
Drop spoonfuls onto the simmering stew, cover and cook 15 minutes without lifting the lid.

recipes.name: Potato Leek Soup
steps: Slice the white and pale green parts of the leeks and rinse well.
Cook the leeks in the butter for 8 minutes until soft, then the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the peeled, cubed potatoes and broth and simmer 20 minutes until soft.
Blend until smooth, stir in the cream and season. Top with chives.

recipes.name: Turkey Chili
steps: Brown the turkey in a little oil in a large pot.
Add the onion and pepper for 5 minutes, then the garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, beans and broth and simmer 25 minutes.
Season and serve with cheese.

swaps.label: Use a chili seasoning packet
swaps.note: Use the chili seasoning in place of the chili powder and cumin.

recipes.name: Sausage Breakfast Casserole
steps: Brown the sausage, breaking it up, and drain.
Spread the bread in a greased 9x13 dish and top with the sausage and cheese.
Whisk the eggs, milk, mustard and 1/2 tsp salt and pour over. Chill at least 1 hour or overnight.
Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 45 minutes until set. Top with green onions.

recipes.name: Western Omelette
steps: Cook the ham, pepper and onion in half the butter for 4 minutes. Set aside.
Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Melt the rest of the butter in the pan, pour in the eggs and cook, pulling the edges in, until nearly set.
Add the filling and cheese to one half, fold over and cook 1 more minute.

recipes.name: Huevos Rancheros
steps: Warm the refried beans and the salsa in separate small pots.
Crisp the tortillas in the oil, 1 minute a side.
Fry the eggs to your liking.
Spread beans on the tortillas, top with eggs, salsa, cheese, avocado and cilantro.

recipes.name: Egg Muffin Cups
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and grease a 12-cup muffin tin.
Whisk the eggs, milk and 1/2 tsp salt.
Divide the spinach, pepper, ham and cheese between the cups and pour the egg over.
Bake 20 to 22 minutes until set. They keep 4 days in the fridge.

recipes.name: Overnight French Toast Bake
steps: Spread the bread in a greased 9x13 dish.
Whisk the eggs, milk, cream, syrup, 1 1/2 tsp cinnamon and vanilla and pour over. Cover and chill overnight.
Mix the brown sugar, melted butter and the rest of the cinnamon and scatter over.
Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 45 minutes until puffed and golden. Serve with syrup.

recipes.name: Homemade Maple Granola
steps: Heat the oven to 325°F (160°C).
Mix the oats, almonds, seeds, cinnamon and salt, then stir in the syrup and oil.
Spread on a lined sheet pan and bake 25 to 30 minutes, stirring halfway, until golden.
Cool on the pan so it clumps, then stir in the cranberries.

recipes.name: Crepes
steps: Blend the flour, eggs, milk, 2 tbsp butter, sugar and salt until smooth. Rest 15 minutes.
Heat a nonstick pan over medium and brush with butter.
Pour in 1/4 cup batter and swirl it thin. Cook 1 minute, flip and cook 30 seconds.
Fill with Nutella and strawberries, or anything you like.

recipes.name: Avocado Toast with Eggs
steps: Toast the bread.
Mash the avocados with the lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
Fry or poach the eggs.
Spread the avocado on the toast, top with the eggs and chili flakes.

recipes.name: Sausage and Potato Hash
steps: Dice the potatoes and microwave them 5 minutes to par-cook.
Brown the sausage in a large skillet, breaking it up. Set aside.
Fry the potatoes in the oil until crisp, 10 minutes, then the onion and pepper for 5 minutes. Stir in the sausage and paprika.
Make 4 wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook 4 minutes until set.

recipes.name: Berry Yogurt Parfaits
steps: Spoon a layer of yogurt into 4 glasses.
Add berries, then granola.
Repeat the layers.
Drizzle with honey.

recipes.name: Cucumber Tomato Salad
steps: Halve the cucumber lengthwise and slice it.
Halve the tomatoes and thinly slice the onion.
Whisk the oil, vinegar, oregano and a pinch of salt.
Toss everything together just before serving.

recipes.name: Honey Roasted Carrots
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Cut the carrots into sticks and toss with the oil, thyme and salt.
Roast 20 minutes.
Melt the honey with the butter, toss with the carrots and roast 5 more minutes.

recipes.name: Green Beans Almondine
steps: Boil the beans in salted water for 4 minutes, then drain.
Toast the almonds in the butter until golden, 2 minutes.
Add the garlic for 30 seconds, then the beans, and toss.
Finish with the lemon juice and salt.

recipes.name: Roasted Brussels Sprouts with Bacon
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Halve the sprouts and toss with the oil, chopped bacon, salt and pepper.
Roast 20 to 25 minutes, turning once, until browned and crisp.
Drizzle with the maple syrup.

recipes.name: Baked Sweet Potato Fries
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Cut the sweet potatoes into 1 cm sticks and toss with the cornstarch, then the oil, paprika and salt.
Spread in one layer on 2 lined pans, not touching.
Bake 25 minutes, turning once, until crisp at the edges.

recipes.name: Taco Salad
steps: Brown the beef, drain, then stir in the taco seasoning and 1/2 cup water and simmer 3 minutes.
Chop the romaine and halve the tomatoes.
Mix the salsa and sour cream for the dressing.
Layer the lettuce, beef, beans, corn, tomatoes, cheese and chips, and pour over the dressing.

recipes.name: Cobb Salad
steps: Season and cook the chicken, 6 minutes a side, then slice. Cook the bacon until crisp and crumble it.
Boil the eggs 10 minutes, cool and quarter.
Whisk the vinegar, oil, mustard and a pinch of salt.
Arrange the chopped romaine with rows of chicken, bacon, egg, avocado, tomatoes and blue cheese. Dress at the table.

recipes.name: Spinach Strawberry Salad
steps: Toast the pecans in a dry pan for 3 minutes.
Thinly slice the onion.
Whisk the vinegar, oil, honey and a pinch of salt.
Toss the spinach, strawberries, onion and dressing, and top with goat cheese and pecans.

recipes.name: Spanish Rice
steps: Fry the rice in the oil over medium heat, stirring, until golden, 5 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic for 2 minutes.
Stir in the tomato sauce, broth, cumin and 1 tsp salt and bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer on low 20 minutes. Rest 5 minutes and fluff.

recipes.name: Caprese Salad
steps: Slice the tomatoes and mozzarella about 1 cm thick.
Alternate them on a platter with basil leaves.
Drizzle with the oil and balsamic glaze.
Season with flaky salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Apple Crisp
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C).
Toss the peeled, sliced apples with the sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon and lemon juice and spread in a 9x13 dish.
Rub the oats, flour, brown sugar, the rest of the cinnamon and the butter together into clumps. Scatter over.
Bake 45 minutes until golden and bubbling.

recipes.name: Fudgy Brownies
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and line an 8x8 pan with parchment.
Melt the butter and stir in the sugar, eggs and vanilla.
Stir in the cocoa, flour and salt, then the chocolate chips.
Bake 22 to 25 minutes until just set in the middle. Cool before cutting.

recipes.name: One-Bowl Chocolate Cake
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and grease two 9-inch pans.
Whisk the flour, sugar, cocoa, baking soda, baking powder and 1 tsp salt.
Beat in the eggs, milk, oil and vanilla, then stir in the hot coffee. The batter is thin.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes. Cool fully, then frost.

recipes.name: Rice Krispie Squares
steps: Butter a 9x13 pan.
Melt the butter in a large pot over low heat, then add the marshmallows and stir until melted.
Off the heat, stir in the vanilla, then the cereal until coated.
Press into the pan with buttered hands. Cool and cut.

recipes.name: Lemon Bars
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Mix the softened butter, 1 cup flour and 1/4 cup icing sugar and press into an 8x8 pan.
Bake the base 18 minutes until pale gold.
Whisk the eggs, sugar, 2 tbsp flour and the zest and juice of the lemons. Pour over the hot base.
Bake 20 minutes until set. Cool, dust with icing sugar and cut.

recipes.name: Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C).
Beat the softened butter and sugar, then the egg and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking soda, cinnamon and a pinch of salt, then the oats and raisins.
Drop spoonfuls onto lined pans and bake 10 to 12 minutes until golden at the edges.

recipes.name: Soft Sugar Cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
Beat the softened butter and sugar until fluffy, then the egg and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking powder, baking soda and a pinch of salt.
Roll into balls, roll them in sugar and bake 8 to 10 minutes until just set.

recipes.name: Pumpkin Bread
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and grease a loaf pan.
Whisk the pumpkin, eggs, sugar and oil.
Stir in the flour, baking soda, spice and salt until just combined.
Bake 60 to 65 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.

recipes.name: Strawberry Shortcake
steps: Slice the strawberries and toss with 1/4 cup sugar. Leave 20 minutes.
Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Mix the flour, baking powder, 2 tbsp sugar and a pinch of salt. Rub in the butter, then stir in the milk.
Pat out 2 cm thick, cut 6 biscuits and bake 12 to 15 minutes until golden.
Whip the cream. Split the biscuits and fill with strawberries and cream.

recipes.name: Homemade Chocolate Pudding
steps: Whisk the sugar, cocoa, cornstarch and a pinch of salt in a pot, then slowly whisk in the milk.
Bring to a simmer over medium heat, whisking, and cook 2 minutes until thick.
Off the heat, stir in the chocolate and vanilla until smooth.
Pour into 4 cups, cover the surface and chill 2 hours.

recipes.name: Peach Cobbler
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Melt the butter in a 9x13 dish in the oven.
Toss the sliced peaches with 1/4 cup sugar and the cinnamon.
Whisk the flour, 3/4 cup sugar, baking powder and milk, and pour over the butter without stirring. Spoon the peaches on top.
Bake 45 minutes until golden.

recipes.name: Vanilla Cupcakes
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a 12-cup muffin tin.
Beat the butter and sugar, then the eggs, vanilla, flour, baking powder and milk until smooth.
Fill the cups two-thirds full and bake 18 to 20 minutes. Cool.
Beat the icing sugar with 1/4 cup soft butter and 2 tbsp milk, and frost.

recipes.name: Snickerdoodles
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
Beat the softened butter and 1 1/2 cups sugar, then the eggs. Stir in the flour, cream of tartar, baking soda and a pinch of salt.
Roll into balls and roll them in the cinnamon mixed with 3 tbsp sugar.
Bake 9 to 10 minutes until set at the edges but soft in the middle.
